input: # XML well-formedness cases that the documented stack currently ACCEPTS.
# Every row here is a document that XML 1.0 forbids, so every row expects an
# ERROR. They are RED as of the conformance-2026-08 baseline and are meant to
# stay red until the leniency is fixed -- do NOT delete or loosen them to get
# green (see the top-level AGENTS.md rule on honest tests).
# Cause: the base tabnas engine's own leniency (character data / line
# comments outside the document element) reaches through @tabnas/xml into
# this plugin. It is NOT introduced by `use(jsonic)`: `new Tabnas().use(Feed)`
# classifies every one of these identically.
# 1. Content after the document element. XML 1.0 s2.1: only Misc (comments,
#    PIs, whitespace) may follow the root. Anything else is a fatal error.
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"><title>x</title></feed> trailing
<rss version="2.0"><channel/></rss>garbage
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>}
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>,
# 2. Engine line/block comment syntax before the document element. `#`, `//`
#    and `/* */` are jsonic/tabnas comment forms, not XML prolog Misc.
# c\n<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>
// c\n<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>
/* c */<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>
# 3. Engine line comment after the document element.
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>// x
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>\n# x
# 4. A second XML declaration. XML 1.0 s2.6 reserves the `xml` PI target; a
#    declaration is only legal as the very first thing in the document.
<?xml version="1.0"?><?xml version="1.0"?><feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"/>
